entries.reason: the Unix-natured rows of files.rs: libgit2's process-wide home is walked to from the root by components that Windows' drives do not share, a directory without the search permission hides its files (Windows' access control does not model it this way), and a FIFO is a file in a directory only on Unix (a Windows named pipe lives in its own namespace); this arm holds those three tests and nothing else
